facts.fact: Instagram had around 2 billion monthly active users as of 2025, according to the page.
facts.quote: With around **2 billion monthly active users** on Instagram as of 2025, you're not exactly playing in an empty field.

facts.fact: The page states that the average person has around 264 Instagram followers, with no source given.
facts.quote: While the average person might have a couple of hundred followers (around 264), successful creator accounts pull in about 6,230 on average.

facts.fact: The page says an Instagram bio is limited to 150 characters.
facts.quote: Your bio isn't just a place to drop a few emojis; it's your 150-character elevator pitch.

facts.fact: The page advises carving out 15-30 minutes every day to engage with other accounts in your niche.
facts.quote: Carve out **15-30 minutes** every single day to go engage with other accounts in your world.

facts.fact: According to Socialinsider.io benchmarks cited on the page, Instagram's overall average engagement rate dropped about 28% year-over-year in early 2025.
facts.quote: the platform's overall average engagement rate dropped by about **28%** year-over-year in early 2025

facts.fact: The page's TV ad guidance says the first three seconds of a TV spot are critical for hooking viewers.
facts.quote: The first three seconds are everything.

facts.fact: The page recommends starting with 10-15 niche hashtags per post.
facts.quote: A good mix to start with is **10-15** niche tags, **5-7** community tags, and just **2-3** of the broader ones.

facts.fact: The page cites Analyzify.com for a 127% rise in Instagram's active user base between 2019 and 2025.
facts.quote: Between 2019 and 2025, Instagram's active user base shot up by a staggering **127%**.

facts.fact: The page states that the 18-24 age group makes up nearly half of Instagram users in key markets.
facts.quote: The 18-24 age group now makes up nearly half of the users in key markets

facts.fact: The page states that fashion drives 25% of all brand interactions on Instagram.
facts.quote: with niches like fashion driving **25%** of all brand interactions

facts.fact: The page recommends posting 3-5 good feed posts or Reels per week, supplemented by daily Stories.
facts.quote: Aim for **3-5 good** feed posts or Reels per week. Then, fill in the gaps with daily Stories to stay familiar.

facts.fact: The page states that meaningful Instagram follower growth takes 6-12 months of consistent effort.
facts.quote: Meaningful growth takes 6-12 months of consistent effort.

facts.fact: The page gives an example of a fake-account warning sign: following 7,000 accounts while having only 12 followers.
facts.quote: like following **7,000** accounts but only having **12** followers.
